meta.name: weekly-digests
meta.description: Generate a serial week-by-week narrative digest of a project's full claude-mem timeline. Splits the timeline into per-ISO-week files, then runs one consecutive subagent per week — each receiving the prior week's carry-forward block — to produce one chapter per ISO week of data. Use when asked for "weekly digests", "week-by-week story", "serial timeline", or "narrative chapters" of a project's history.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把项目历史按周生成连续叙事回顾
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望把项目记录自动整理成每周连续的叙事摘要
copy.tagline_en: Turn your project timeline into a week-by-week narrative.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want automatic weekly narrative summaries of your project history.

howto.what: 装上后,在项目已有 claude-mem 时间线数据时,Claude 会把它按 ISO 自然周分成若干份,再按周顺序派子代理各写一章;每章开头承接上一章的交接块,产出一套按周分章、前后衔接的连载叙事周报。
howto.when: 需要 claude-mem worker 在运行且项目至少有一个 ISO 周的观测记录;当用户提出 “weekly digests”“week-by-week story” 等按周分章回顾时触发。想只要一份总报告时改用 timeline-report。

say.text: 给这个项目生成 weekly digests
say.note: 会按 ISO 周拆分时间线并逐章写入文档。

say.text: 把这个项目的时间线按周分章,讲成连载故事
say.note: 子代理会从第一周开始顺序执行。

say.text: 从最早一周到最近一周,每周写一章这个项目的周报
say.note: 最后一周用 Where We Are 收尾,不写交接块。

howto.what_en: Installed: Claude splits a project's claude-mem timeline into ISO-week files, then runs one subagent per week in date order (each gets the previous week's carry-forward block) to write one chapter per week.
howto.when_en: Triggers on "weekly digests", "week-by-week story", etc. Requires claude-mem worker and ≥1 ISO week of data; single overview reports use timeline-report.

say_en.text: Generate weekly digests for this project.
say_en.note: Splits the timeline by ISO week and writes chapters in order.

say_en.text: Tell this project's history as a week-by-week serial story.
say_en.note: Chapters run sequentially from the first week.

say_en.text: Write one chapter per week, from earliest to latest week.
say_en.note: Final chapter closes with Where We Are.
